subject: Media Literacy
title: Writing Systems Change Everything
description: A micro-lesson that makes Writing Systems Change Everything usable.

hook.text: Around 3200 BCE, Sumerian merchants pressed reed styluses into wet clay. Writing was born.

buildup.text: Writing began as accounting — tracking grain and livestock — not poetry or philosophy.

discovery.text: Once information could be stored outside the brain, knowledge could travel without a messenger.

twist.text: For millennia, literacy was restricted to elites. Writing was power, and power was hoarded.

climax.text: Writing didn't just record ideas — it made complex societies, laws, and empires possible.

punchline.text: Writing was invented for receipts, not literature.

quiz.question: What was writing originally invented to track?
options: Trade goods like grain and livestock
